propositions: Risky runtime mechanisms (service boot, credential authorization, dependency connectivity, readiness checks) are discovered only at the end of slow delivery cycles, not front-loaded into cheap local or manual experiments.
No existing plan-review criterion rewards proving runtime-only correctness before committing a mechanism into an automated pipeline or IaC apply.

When T15 applies, plans must name specific mechanisms confirmable only by completing the full loop, and commit to a fast out-of-loop proof (local reproduction or real-target manual experiment) before codifying the slow loop.
Throwaway experiments used to de-risk mechanisms must have scoped cleanup that removes only artifacts created by the experiment, not pre-existing or shared resources.
T10 durable-infrastructure scope must be partitioned from T15 transient experiments to prevent overlap and cross-criterion suppression.
